playerProfile.name: Aleksander Barkov

scoutReport.generalImpressions: Aleksander Barkov his skating is among the best in the league. His wrist shot is a genuine weapon. A prolific goal scorer with excellent instincts in front of net. Threads passes into impossible lanes. Reads the play well and anticipates lanes others miss. Wins puck battles along the wall. Extremely strong on the puck. Will do whatever it takes to win. His dedication and preparation are exemplary. Has the flair to pull off the highlight-reel move. Brings a combative style that gets under opponents' skin. Is the kind of player you want on the ice in crunch time.

paragraphs: Aleksander has put up 11 points (5G, 6A) in 13 games in the NHL — a strong scoring pace. Useful output, even if it does not jump off the page.
The calling card is his hockey sense and puckhandling and playmaking. He profiles as a two-way forward who high-end shot. He reads the game at a high level and rarely looks rushed.
Our scouts project him as Franchise F. Our staff is confident in this read.
